places.name: Pyramids of Giza
places.clue: The Great Pyramid was the tallest human-made structure on Earth for nearly 4,000 years.

places.name: Alexandria
places.clue: Its ancient lighthouse, the Pharos, was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

places.name: Luxor
places.clue: Ancient Thebes: across the Nile lies the Valley of the Kings, where Tutankhamun was buried.

places.name: Abu Simbel
places.clue: Ramesses II's colossal temples were cut into blocks and moved uphill in the 1960s to escape the rising waters of Lake Nasser.

places.name: Aswan
places.clue: Its granite quarries supplied ancient obelisks, and an unfinished one still lies cracked in the bedrock.

places.name: Siwa Oasis
places.clue: Alexander the Great crossed the desert to consult the oracle of Amun at this remote oasis near the Libyan border.

places.name: Mount Sinai
places.clue: At its foot stands Saint Catherine's Monastery, one of the oldest working Christian monasteries in the world.

places.name: Port Said
places.clue: Founded in 1859 to house the workers digging the Suez Canal, it guards the canal's northern entrance.

places.name: Hurghada
places.clue: Once a small fishing village, it grew into one of the Red Sea's busiest diving and beach resorts.

places.name: Abydos
places.clue: The Temple of Seti I here holds the Abydos King List, a carved roll call of dozens of earlier pharaohs.

places.name: Wadi Al-Hitan
places.clue: Fossil skeletons of ancient whales, complete with tiny hind legs, lie across this desert valley that was once a seabed.

places.name: Kharga Oasis
places.clue: Its Temple of Hibis, dedicated to Amun, is one of the best-preserved temples from Egypt's Persian period.
